title: Jesus Is Baptized
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Jesus came from Nazareth to the Jordan River. He asked John to baptize Him. John was surprised. “I need You to baptize me!” he said.
Jesus said, “Let it be so. It is right to do all that is good.” Jesus had never done anything wrong. But He wanted to obey Heavenly Father in everything.
So John baptized Jesus, under the water and up again.
p2: When Jesus came up, the heavens opened. The Holy Ghost came down like a dove and rested on Him. A voice said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
It was Heavenly Father, happy with His dearly loved Son. He is happy when you obey too. Tonight, tell Him one way you will obey tomorrow.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
